name: Indiana

context: IN 340: Aim for at least 90-percent combined canopy and residue cover during the period of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
IN 340: Time cover crop establishment with other practices so the soil is protected during the critical erosion periods.
cover_rules: IN 340: Plant the cover crop as early as possible and terminate as late as practical (late vegetative stage or later).
IN 340: Use current erosion prediction technology to set the surface and canopy cover the cover crop must provide.
residue: IN 329: Maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
IN 345: The crop interval STIR value rating shall be no greater than 80.
seeding: Grass seeding: Indiana planting depth is 0.25-0.5 inches for most grasses listed; rates are lb PLS/acre.
pasture: IN 512: Pasture and hayland rates in lb PLS/acre: orchardgrass 4-6, smooth bromegrass 5-7, tall fescue 6-10, timothy 2-4.
disturbed: IN 342: Critical area planting rates in lb PLS/acre: switchgrass 8-10, tall fescue 25-50, orchardgrass 13-20.
